requirement_evidence.evidence: Implemented select and smoke commands. Policy selection evaluated strictly on validation split (val) without touching test set; objective (maximize certified reuse subject to zero disagreements) and tie-breaking rules strictly applied. Verified by test_w4_030_c01_and_c07_validation_selection_and_test_protection.

Evaluated candidate policies across declared limits: build cap (128), cooldown (0, 4), horizon (1, 2), identity mode (OWNED_GENERATION); included mandatory zero-radius control (marked ineligible) and no-build control. Verified by test_w4_030_c02_and_c03_policy_controls_and_separate_metrics.

Recorded separate scores for candidate proposals, conditional positives, joint members, eligible hits, disagreements, build latency, and failures. Zero timeouts observed. Verified by test_w4_030_c02_and_c03_policy_controls_and_separate_metrics.
Proposals generated label-free around anchor window; next query used strictly for offline outcome evaluation. Verified by test_w4_030_c04_label_free_proposals_and_smoke_command.

Cryptographic seal protocol_seal.json generated with master seal hash, config hashes (protocol.json, methods.json), artifact hashes, and code hashes; discloses KNOWN_TEST_EXPLORATORY level. Verified by test_w4_030_c05_c06_c07_protocol_seal_and_immutability.

Seal verification detects any post-seal modification to configs or source code; modifying any tracked file invalidates seal and prevents stale test replay. Verified by test_w4_030_c05_c06_c07_protocol_seal_and_immutability.

Confirmed deterministic selection, zero-hit tie breaking, NONE_ELIGIBLE_FORMAL_REUSE_ZERO_HIT verdict under H06/H19, refusal of unauthorized test split evaluation, and fail-closed rejection of stale hashes. Verified by test_w4_030_c01_and_c07_validation_selection_and_test_protection.
